content:
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill and verified there is no found_smells directory to process first.
- Checked git status; only existing .ralph task/progress files were dirty before code changes.
- Scanned src/tests for likely boundary smells and narrowed candidates to helper-heavy or string-rendering code paths, with src/command/mod.rs looking promising.
- Next: inspect the chosen module, prove one helper/shape smell, refactor it, then run lint/tests/commit/push/task switch.

- Proved a smell-10 helper in src/config/schema.rs by renaming all_child_bin_dirs and running make check; compiler failure showed the only real caller was conventional_postgres_bin_dirs.
- Refactored schema.rs to delete the fake wrapper helpers and keep one real reusable helper, child_bin_dirs_matching, which now owns the directory->bin path conversion directly.
- Caught and fixed a bad intermediate edit in the new call sites before verification.
- Next: run make lint and make test, then commit/push and switch tasks.

- make lint passed after the schema boundary cleanup.
- make test passed: 242 tests run, 242 passed, 16 skipped; nextest still reported 5 leaky reload-certificates tests in api::worker.
- Checked Ralph bug tasks and confirmed this leak is already tracked in existing bug files, so I did not create a duplicate bug.
- Next: inspect final diff/status, commit including .ralph changes, push, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
